title: Method overloading
answer: Method overloading means declaring multiple methods with the same name but different parameter lists. The compiler chooses the applicable overload using the compile-time argument types and conversion rules; the return type alone cannot distinguish overloads. AeroTopo's `LanguageLab.join` is overloaded for `int` and `Integer`, giving callers two signatures while keeping one conceptual operation name.
